aliases: L5Q Quick Deploy LPR Camera System
features: redeployable all-in-one quick-deploy LPR camera system (predecessor of the L6Q)
optimal distance 50 ft (15 m), capture range < 75 ft (23 m)
capture speed up to 85 mph (recommended deployment 45 mph or less)
flexible AC/DC or solar power (10W solar panel, 108 Wh battery)
pairs with Vigilant PlateSearch or Vigilant ClientPortal
